title: Food and Liquor at 20
hook: 20 years ago this month, Food and Liquor dropped.
voiceover: 20 years ago this month, Food and Liquor dropped. September 19, 2006, Lupe Fiasco, 1st and 15th and Atlantic. Everyone posts the skateboard. The part nobody posts is where Kick, Push comes from. Producer Soundtrakk built it on Bolero Medley, a 1979 record by Celeste Legaspi, a singer from the Philippines. Those strings and that rising vocal line are Manila, not Chicago. So the biggest skateboard record in rap is a Filipino ballad from the 70s, chopped and looped, which sums up the whole album, a West Side Chicago kid pulling from everywhere. Ask your Filipino friends, their parents know that record. Where were you when this dropped?
caption: Lupe Fiasco's Food and Liquor, 1st and 15th / Atlantic, September 19, 2006. 20 years. Kick, Push, produced by Soundtrakk, is built on Bolero Medley by Celeste Legaspi (1979), a Filipino singer. Chicago rap on a Manila ballad, and somehow it's the most skateboard record ever made. Where were you when this dropped? 🛹
